name: Trade Republic
summary: Trade Republic is a Berlin-based investing app and bank offering low-cost stock, ETF and crypto trading and savings accounts across Europe.
overview: Trade Republic is a European broker and fully licensed bank offering stocks, ETFs, crypto, private-market products and savings accounts through a mobile app.
bull_case: Profitability, a banking licence and Europe's low share of retail investing give Trade Republic a long runway.
bear_case: EU rules on payment for order flow, falling interest rates and competition from banks and brokers could squeeze revenue.
directory_notes: Impact of EU trading-fee regulation and interest rates.

intelligence.description: Trade Republic is a European broker and fully licensed bank offering stocks, ETFs, crypto, private-market products and savings accounts through a mobile app.
company: Trade Republic was founded in Berlin in 2015 and offers low-cost investing in stocks, ETFs and crypto, along with savings accounts. It received a full banking licence from the European Central Bank in December 2023.

In a $1.40 billion secondary share sale completed around the turn of 2026, investors including Founders Fund, Fidelity, GIC and Wellington bought shares at a $14.6 billion valuation, up from $5.36 billion in 2022. The company says it has been profitable for three years and does not need new capital.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Trade Republic is Europe's leading retail-investing platform and a read-through for the shift of European savings into markets, and for how Robinhood-style businesses are valued in Europe.

changed.text: Trade Republic is founded in Berlin.
A $268M Series C extension values it at $5.36B.
It receives a full banking licence from the ECB.
A $1.40B secondary sale values it at $14.6B.

takeaways: The latest valuation comes from a secondary sale, not new money into the company.
It is profitable, which is rare for a fast-growing fintech.
A banking licence lets it earn interest income as well as trading fees.
Regulation of payment for order flow in the EU is a risk to trading revenue.
